summary: End-to-end tested Bukuku Pro (Indonesian bookkeeping). Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass covering Settings CRUD, Transactions CRUD, Records (Piutang/Utang) with settle/unsettle/delete auto-transaction cascade, Profit-Shares idempotency + delete, Backup/Restore, and bulk Import. Frontend: playwright smoke covered app load, initial saldo from settings, add/edit/delete transaction with running balance, nominal thousand-dot auto-format, add Piutang record + one-click Lunas auto-creating cash Pemasukan, tab navigation (Buku Kas / Rekap Bulanan / Laba Rugi / Piutang & Utang), and dashboard totals. All flows working; no critical issues.

minor.issue: Uses delete_many + insert_many without a transaction/session; a partial failure mid-restore could leave DB in inconsistent state. Low risk since it's an admin-only flow.
Uses server UTC date (datetime.now(UTC).strftime) for the auto-transaction tanggal; if server timezone differs from user (WIB is UTC+7), a late-evening settle can be recorded on the previous day.
Silently returns existing record without updating laba_bersih/bagian_* when called again for the same bulan. This is idempotent as spec'd, but there is no PUT to update if net profit later changes.

issues: Header shows 'Laba September 2026' because container clock reports Sept 2026 - not a bug per se, but users in Jan 2026 will find it confusing. Consider showing month based on latest data rather than system clock, or a warning if clock is far in the future.

action_items: Optional: Consider using local (WIB) date instead of UTC when generating auto-settle transaction tanggal.
Optional: Add PUT /api/profit-shares/{bulan} to update laba_bersih if a user re-marks after edits.
Optional: Wrap /api/restore in a mongo session/transaction for atomicity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id in all reads.
Uses @app.on_event('shutdown') - deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handlers eventually.
TransactionCreate has no field validators (nominal>=0, kategori enum, tanggal ISO format). Backend trusts frontend; consider Pydantic validators for defense in depth.
App.js is compact (~140 lines) and delegates well to feature components. No refactor needed.
seed_data_creation: Tests use snapshot-and-restore fixture; DB is wiped before each test and original state restored after suite. Cleanup is automatic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with pytest (single worker preferred since tests share DB state - override via `-o addopts=''` if xdist parallelism causes flakes). UI critical flows: kas-total-saldo updates correctly across add/edit/delete/settle. Env: server clock reports Sept 2026 so month labels reflect that.
rca of the issue: N/A - no issues found requiring RCA.
